description: Kaigen, the 3D engine built for AI coding agents: install, sign in, make a game from a template, build, screenshot and publish it with one CLI that answers in JSON. One C codebase ships native to the web (WebGPU), Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android and VR.
rules: Pass --json to every kaigen command and read the JSON answer; never parse the human log lines.
Inside a game, build and run with hz/hzbuild (Windows: hz\hzbuild), never a system compiler.
Read the game's AGENTS.md and hz/wiki/index.md before writing engine code; the engine has no libc, no malloc and no printf.
Prove every change with a scripted offscreen run: hz/hzbuild --commands "2:screenshot;3:quit" -- --offscreen, then look at out/screenshot_commands.png.
kaigen doctor --json answers every setup problem with the command that fixes it; run that remediation.
Publish to a playable link with kaigen games publish . --json.
